```{r}
#| include: false
if (!exists("CAP", inherits = FALSE)) CAP <- readCaption("tbl.cda")
root <- here::here()
if (!exists("CdaTable", inherits = FALSE)) {
  CdaTable <- data.table(
    "Class" = c("Low", "Significant", "High", "Very High", "Extreme"),
    "Population at risk" = c("None", "Temporary only", "Permanent", "Permanent", "Permanent"
    ),
    "Loss of life" = c("0", "Unspecified", "10 or fewer", "100 or fewer", "More than 100"
    ),
    "Construction, Operation and Transition" = c("1/100", "Between 1/100 and 1/1,000", "1/2,475", "1/2 between 1/2,475 and 1/10,000, or MCE",
    "1/10,000, or MCE"),
    "Closure and Passive Care" = c("1/1,000", "1/2,475", "1/2 between 1/2,475 and 1/10,000, or MCE",
    "1/10,000, or MCE", "1/10,000, or MCE")
  )
  CdaNotes <- c("CDA Technical Bulletin Table 3-1, after Table 2-1 of the CDA Dam Safety Guidelines.",
  "Annual exceedance probability for earthquakes, CDA Technical Bulletin Table 3-3. ",
  "The 1/2,475 level is anchored to the National Building Code of Canada.",
  "Annual exceedance probability for earthquakes, CDA Technical Bulletin Table 4-2. ",
  "Closure under active care with regular monitoring retains the Table 3-3 levels."
  )
}
```

```{r}
#| include: true
#| label: tbl-cda
#| tbl-cap: !expr CAP
source(file.path(root, "scripts", "tbl", "cda.R"))
TBL
```

```{r}
#| include: false
rm(list = intersect(c("CAP", "CdaTable", "CdaNotes"), ls()))
```
